bio: I’m a frontend developer and designer with a weakness for chunky borders, loud typography, and soft candy colors. I turn messy ideas into memorable interfaces that feel a little bit playful and a lot deliberate.
Outside code, I collect vintage keyboards, experiment with 3D tools, and take pictures of oddly shaped clouds.
facts: Built my first website when I was 13
Can debug better after a strong coffee
I sketch every interface before coding
